name: Manager creates an agent with explicit username and password
description: A manager adds a new agent by filling the agent name plus a login username and a strong password, can toggle password visibility, and the new agent then appears in the agents list. IMPORTANT: the agent edit dialog only contains name/phone/region fields — it has NO username field — so verification must happen in the agents list only and the edit dialog must NOT be opened.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Open the agents section (الوكلاء المعتمدين) from the manager dashboard
Open the add-agent form (إضافة وكيل نظام)
Enter a unique agent name, a unique login username, and the password Ts@12345x in the credential fields, and a unique phone number starting with 7 in the phone field
Toggle the password visibility switch on and confirm the password text becomes visible, then toggle it off
Submit the add agent form by clicking the confirm button (تأكيد وتسجيل الوكيل)
Wait for the form to close and return to the agents list

Verify the newly created agent appears in the agents list with the entered name. Do NOT open the agent card, do NOT open the edit modal — the edit modal has no username field and is out of scope for this test.
